name: radare2
description: Advanced reverse engineering framework with comprehensive binary analysis and debugging tools

tools.description: Remote agent for radare2 allowing network-based reverse engineering sessions
tools.usage:
r2agent -p 9999 # Listen on port 9999
r2agent -H 0.0.0.0 -p 8080 # Bind to all interfaces
r2agent -a x86 # Specify architecture
r2agent -s # Use SSL/TLS encryption

tools.description: Package manager for radare2 plugins and extensions
tools.usage:
r2pm update # Update package database
r2pm search keyword # Search for packages
r2pm install package_name # Install package
r2pm list # List installed packages
r2pm uninstall package_name # Remove package

tools.description: Test runner for radare2 regression testing and validation
tools.usage:
r2r test_file.r2 # Run specific test
r2r -j tests/ # Run tests with JSON output
r2r -v tests/ # Verbose test execution
r2r -i # Interactive test mode

tools.description: Binary analysis tool for extracting information from executables
tools.usage:
rabin2 -I binary.exe # Show file info
rabin2 -i binary.exe # List imports
rabin2 -E binary.exe # Show exports
rabin2 -S binary.exe # List sections
rabin2 -z binary.exe # Extract strings

tools.description: Advanced reverse engineering framework with disassembler and debugger
tools.usage:
radare2 binary.exe # Open binary for analysis
r2 -A binary.exe # Auto-analyze binary
r2 -d program.exe # Debug mode
r2 -w binary.exe # Write mode
r2 -B 0x1000 mem.dump # Set base address

tools.description: Binary diffing tool for comparing executables and finding differences between versions
tools.usage:
radiff2 file1.exe file2.exe # Basic binary diff
radiff2 -g file1.exe file2.exe # Graphical diff output
radiff2 -A file1.exe file2.exe # Unified diff format
radiff2 -C file1.exe file2.exe # Code analysis diff

tools.description: Advanced search tool for finding patterns, strings, and bytes in binary files
tools.usage:
rafind2 -s 'string' file.bin # Search for string
rafind2 -x 4142434445 file.bin # Search hex bytes
rafind2 -e /regex/i file.bin # Regex search
rafind2 -z file.bin # Find null-terminated strings

tools.description: Shellcode compiler and payload generator for exploit development
tools.usage:
ragg2 -a x86 -b 64 shellcode.r # Compile shellcode
ragg2 -F elf64 -o payload shellcode.r # Generate ELF payload
ragg2 -P print_shellcode.r # Print generated code
ragg2 -L # List available architectures

tools.description: Cryptographic hash calculator supporting multiple algorithms for file integrity verification
tools.usage:
rahash2 file.exe # Default hash (SHA1)
rahash2 -a md5 file.exe # MD5 hash
rahash2 -a sha256 file.exe # SHA256 hash
rahash2 -c hash_to_verify file.exe # Verify against hash
rahash2 -B 1024 file.exe # Hash specific block size

tools.description: Binary patching tool for applying modifications and fixes to executable files
tools.usage:
rapatch2 -p patch.r2 binary.exe # Apply patch file
rapatch2 -w 0x1000 "41414141" binary.exe # Write hex at offset
rapatch2 -r 0x1000:10 binary.exe # Read bytes at offset
rapatch2 -s old_bytes new_bytes binary.exe # Replace bytes

tools.description: Process launcher and runtime environment controller for debugging and analysis
tools.usage:
rarun2 program=target.exe # Launch program for debugging
rarun2 program=target.exe arg1=value # Launch with arguments
rarun2 stdin=input.txt program=target.exe # Redirect stdin
rarun2 timeout=30 program=target.exe # Set execution timeout

tools.description: Function signature generator and matcher for binary analysis and library identification
tools.usage:
rasign2 -g signature.sig binary.exe # Generate signatures
rasign2 -a signature.sig target.exe # Apply signatures to target
rasign2 -f function_name binary.exe # Sign specific function
rasign2 -r # Remove all signatures

tools.description: Multi-architecture assembler and disassembler supporting numerous CPU architectures
tools.usage:
rasm2 -a x86 -b 64 'mov rax, rbx' # Assemble x86-64 instruction
rasm2 -a arm -d '0x12345678' # Disassemble ARM bytes
rasm2 -L # List supported architectures
rasm2 -f input.asm # Assemble from file

tools.description: Version control system for radare2 projects and analysis session management
tools.usage:
ravc2 init project_name # Initialize new project
ravc2 save checkpoint1 # Save analysis state
ravc2 load checkpoint1 # Load saved state
ravc2 diff checkpoint1 checkpoint2 # Compare states
ravc2 log # Show project history

tools.description: Number base converter and mathematical calculator for various numeric formats
tools.usage:
rax2 0x1000 # Convert hex to decimal
rax2 -b 4096 # Convert decimal to hex
rax2 -k 10+20*3 # Mathematical expressions
rax2 -s hello # String to hex conversion
rax2 -S 48656c6c6f # Hex to string conversion
